Context: 9. Relaxations / Concessions in Promotions.-

- Order 12, Section 1.  
- (ix) Zone of consideration of candidates for promotion.When sufficient number of SC/ST candidates are not available in the normal zone of consideration for promotion to selection posts, the normal zone will be extended to five times the number of vacancies in respect of SC/ST candidates only. - Order 28, Section 2.
